title: hemiphlebium hookeri
intro: Hemiphlebium hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's hemiphlebium, is a type of fern native to tropical regions in Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hemiphlebium hookeri include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its wound-healing and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
